snippet.title: v8.4 For the Stars Shall Defy Fate - Honkai Impact 3rd
snippet.description:
v8.4 For the Stars Shall Defy Fate is coming soon. Coralie 6626 Planck's new S-rank battlesuit "Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon" debuts!
Part 2 Main Story Chapter IX Interlude: Yet the Stars Still Sparkle, featured event "Assemble! Summer Friendship Resort", new outfits, and more exciting content to be released! Stay tuned!
Voice Artists:
Dreamseeker: Yuki Nakashima
Vita: Yoko Hikasa
Coralie 6626 Planck: Saya Aizawa
